frontend.subtitle: The only surface a user ever touches. A hand-rolled Next.js 16 app (Turbopack, App Router) hosted as a Databricks App — not AppKit, not a separate hosting provider.
facts: OAuth client-credentials service principal, auto-injected by the Apps platform (DATABRICKS_HOST / CLIENT_ID / CLIENT_SECRET)
x-forwarded-email header, injected by the Apps proxy on every request
Relays the Supervisor's Responses-API SSE stream into a simplified text / tool_call / done protocol
items: Cinematic scroll-driven story covering every business case, linking into Capabilities.
/chat/[persona] — 7 personas (General + 6 role-specific), capabilities navbar for cross-navigation.
/capabilities — one slide per persona with an “Open this assistant” call to action.
Per-user session list scoped by x-forwarded-email, resumable, rehydrates casting/memo/contract cards from stored JSON.
Slot-filling state machines for compliance memos and contract uploads — no forms.

session-store.subtitle: Lakebase — Databricks' managed Postgres — stores chat history and session state. The one component the Supervisor and its tools never touch directly; only the frontend talks to it.
facts: node-postgres (pg) with an async password callback
items: id, session_id, role, content, tool_calls JSONB, created_at

supervisor.subtitle: Agent Bricks Multi-Agent Supervisor — the router and synthesizer. It never queries data itself; every fact comes back through a tool call.
facts: native “Genie Space” tool type, one per domain
auto-logs MLflow Traces, one child span per tool call
items: Compound questions call every relevant source instead of short-circuiting on the first strong match.
Conflicting signals across sources are stated explicitly, not silently resolved into one narrative.
Max one retry per entity, hard cap of 4-5 Genie calls per turn — added after a typo caused a 5-call/104s retry storm.
Responses API SSE: output_text.delta for live tokens, function_call items for tool invocations.

genie-spaces.subtitle: Each space is scoped to one domain schema plus dim_title/dim_region for name resolution only — cross-domain reasoning is the Supervisor's job, not Genie's.
facts: ~5 req/min on Free Edition — mitigated with caching, pre-warming, capped fan-out
ILIKE + levenshtein fuzzy matching, not exact =, after the typo-retry incident
Space E (Support) and Space F (Competitive) — product decision, 2026-08-25

document-agent.subtitle: The pre-planned cold-spare that replaced Agent Bricks' Knowledge Assistant, which is confirmed unsupported on Free Edition (HTTP 500 on every query).
facts: dataflix.docs.search_documents(search_query, region_filter) — a plain UC SQL function
doc_registry.source_type = real_public | synthetic, tracked per document
items: MPA, CBFC ×2, EU AVMSD, India IT Rules 2021, IAMAI OTT code, UK BBFC, Japan Eirin, Brazil ×2 (translated via ai_translate)
Per-title licensing contracts, generated to match real fact_licensing rows
search_documents() doesn't expose source_type itself — the compliance-memo pipeline joins back to doc_registry to hard-filter to real citations only

ai-pipelines.subtitle: Three chat features that bypass the Supervisor entirely — the SQL/tables/functions needed are already known, so there's no NL2SQL ambiguity or Genie quota to spend.
facts: Direct calls to the SQL Statement Execution API from Node, same OAuth token as everything else
runSql() now polls to a real terminal state instead of trusting the 50s-capped first response
items: ai_parse_document → ai_summarize + ai_extract → Vector Search actor profiles + ai_analyze_sentiment → real TMDB career stats → ai_query ranking + per-character casting
Fuzzy title resolve → licensing/certification facts → real-only regulatory excerpts → ai_query synthesis → one-page PDF (pdfkit)
PDF upload → ai_parse_document → ai_extract (enum-constrained schema) → fuzzy title resolve → MERGE INTO fact_licensing
flow: ai_extract / ai_summarize / ai_query reason over it
Result written back to Unity Catalog or rendered as a document

unity-catalog.subtitle: One catalog (dataflix), one schema per domain — deliberately mirrors the Genie Space boundaries so scoping stays simple.
facts: 130 real TMDB titles underpin every synthetic business table via title_id
Real data (core.real_watch_providers) and fictional data (licensing.fact_licensing) are tracked separately, never blended
items: dim_title, dim_actor, title_cast, dim_region, real_watch_providers, dim_title_certification — all real TMDB data

sql-warehouse.subtitle: A single serverless/Pro warehouse — a real Free Edition constraint, not a design choice. Every AI Function call and every Genie query ultimately runs here.
facts: 50s server-side, regardless of the value requested
A stopped warehouse can take 30-60s to resume — long enough to blow past that cap
runSql() polls GET /api/2.0/sql/statements/{id} to a terminal state instead of trusting the first response

model-serving.subtitle: Three foundation-model endpoints, invoked almost exclusively through SQL AI Functions rather than direct REST calls from Node.
facts: ai_parse_document, ai_extract, ai_summarize, ai_analyze_sentiment, ai_query, ai_translate, VECTOR_SEARCH
items: Text generation — ai_query, backs ai_extract/ai_summarize, and the Supervisor's own reasoning
The only vision-capable endpoint on this workspace — poster and thumbnail tagging
Embeddings for both Vector Search indexes (documents + actor profiles)

mlflow-eval.subtitle: A regression gate that runs after every build tier, not a pre-demo checklist — real chat traces and eval-run traces share one experiment.
facts: 10 questions: anchor question + persona variants + single-source isolation cases + one adversarial conflicting-signal case + one nonexistent-title case
items: Compares answers against expected_facts for questions with known ground truth
Per-row guideline text — covers both the conflict-surfacing case and the hallucination check
Custom scorer — checks the actual called-tool set against expected_tools_called
Pending full Document Agent wiring into the eval set

external-data.subtitle: Everything that isn't invented. Fetched once, outside the workspace — Free Edition's outbound network allowlist is a real constraint for arbitrary external calls from serverless compute.
facts: Run locally, not as a Databricks Job — then uploaded as a static extract
items: 130 titles (100 movies + 30 TV, Hollywood + Bollywood), cast, poster art, real vote_average / popularity / watch-provider / certification data
MPA, CBFC ×2, EU AVMSD, India IT Rules 2021, IAMAI OTT code, UK BBFC, Japan Eirin, Brazil Ministry of Justice ×2 (translated via ai_translate)
